rationale: The reuse finding (src/pricing.ts:1) explicitly states that formatPrice duplicates formatMoney, covering all four aspects: currency symbol handling (ternary vs dictionary), digit grouping (regex vs loop, every 3 digits), sign (-€5.01), and fraction padding. It names the existing primitive formatMoney in src/money.ts as the reuse target, backed by behavioral comparison against test/money.test.ts inputs. The remedy is aligned: delete formatPrice and call formatMoney at call sites, with any needed currency-symbol map moved into money.ts once rather than keeping a second implementation (it even advises against adding tests for the duplicate since it should be removed). Location criterion is satisfied with the file path and line number.
